gloss: suffrage, right to participate in government

definitions.gloss: suffrage, political rights, right to participate in government
definitions.explanation: The right of citizens to participate in political processes, including the right to vote and the right to run for office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参政権|さんせいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
{参政権|さんせいけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2015⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法改正|ほうかいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{参政権|さんせいけん}のうち⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満|まん}18⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げられた→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, a 2015 amendment extended the right to vote, one of the political rights, to people aged 18 and over.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{参政|さんせい} (participation in government) + ⟦{権|けん}→〜権：31354_ken⟧ (right). {参政|さんせい} itself is {参|さん} (participate) + {政|せい} (politics).

USAGE:
Includes both ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧ (right to vote) and ⟦{被選挙権|ひせんきょけん}→被選挙権：24950_hisenkyoken⟧ (right to run for office). Often appears in discussions of history, civics, and constitutional law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参政権|さんせいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to recognize suffrage
- {参政権|さんせいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to grant suffrage
- {参政権|さんせいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to obtain suffrage
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{参政権|さんせいけん}: women's suffrage
